fusions.name: Reaping Arc
fusions.desc: Sweeps a wide cone ahead of you, dealing 14 damage to everything caught in it and leaving each [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Long Harvest
fusions.desc: A long sweeping blow that deals 30 damage, rising to 2 times that at maximum range, and 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Gathered Breath
fusions.desc: Restores 3 stamina a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Reaper's Eye
fusions.desc: Against enemies below half health, you deal 15% more damage.
